attempts.summary: Segmented node2 (VLAN 10) and node3 (VLAN 20) over their shared trunk link (node1's eth1, node2/node3's enp8s0 — a second NIC separate from the 10.100.227.0/24 management network), and configured node1 (VyOS) to route between the VLANs. Implemented entirely via Ansible run from node4, the cluster's designated control node (the only node with ansible/ansible-playbook installed). Verified with packet captures that traffic is genuinely 802.1Q-tagged and L3-routed (not bridged) through node1, confirmed VLAN isolation (untagged traffic on the shared link no longer reaches node3), and completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes with boot-identity proof and post-restart recovery verification.
